body.batch_driver_detail: continuous batching is active: up to 4 generations share each decode step

kv_pages_shared.detail: paged-KV telemetry is served by the KV block-table endpoint; this node-status contract is model-agnostic and carries no engine reference

kv_pages_total.detail: paged-KV telemetry is served by the KV block-table endpoint; this node-status contract is model-agnostic and carries no engine reference

kv_pages_used.detail: paged-KV telemetry is served by the KV block-table endpoint; this node-status contract is model-agnostic and carries no engine reference

kv_usage.detail: paged-KV telemetry is served by the KV block-table endpoint; this node-status contract is model-agnostic and carries no engine reference

paused_sessions.detail: the driver runs generations to completion without preemption, so no session can be paused

prefix_hashes.detail: the engine does not surface system-prompt prefix hashes; an empty list would claim none are cached

tokens_per_second.detail: only a cumulative token count is recorded; a lifetime average would misreport as a current rate -- see the latency histograms on /metrics

unavailable.detail: this model's KV cache holds no paged tensor storage, so the page table is bookkeeping the decoder never consults
